result.name: teusink
result.title: Teusink 2000 yeast glycolysis (external PMR CellML, 14 states, stiff regions)
result.description: The realistic, many-parameter case: recover four enzyme v_max values from metabolite time courses of the Teusink 2000 glycolysis model, taken from the Physiome Model Repository as external CellML (originally a BioModels SBML export). 14 coupled metabolite states and 90 constants, with stiff regions in the search box -- a much harder calibration than the small oscillator benchmarks.
result.env_note: 8 MPI rank(s); 5000 cost evaluations for the population methods; 16 starts for multi-start
